svg.title: The cell partition and its volume hold also at arity zero, when both the configuration space and the grid consist of one point and h0 m = 1. This proves convergence of (PT16) to the desired continuum integral with its correct normalization. The Gaussian row limit is reduced to a two-point covariance limit by an exact finite recursion. Give every occurrence of every generator in the finitely many local polynomial labels a distinguish- able index a. Let τ(a) be its insertion slot and let ζa be its field-generator label.
